# bcpack-gpu-sdk — AI Agent & Ecosystem Discovery Index (v0.11.0)

> Standalone clean-room GPU Compute SDK (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`) extracted from `POMXARK/bcpack-gpu-hlsl` for Xbox Series translation layers, DirectStorage hooks, Vulkan 1.3 layers, and `bcpack-rs` consumers.

## Exact Problems Solved & Search Keywords
- `BCPack` / `IDStorageQueueX` / `dstorage` CPU decompression bottleneck (~40 MB/s CPU -> `11,327.6 MB/s` GPU BC1 / `6,024.0 MB/s` GPU BC7 rANS)
- Zero-copy DX12 C-ABI (`bcpack_gpu.dll`, `include/bcpack_gpu.h`): `bcpack_gpu_create_from_device`, `BcPackDecodeToBuffer`, `BcPackDecodeToTexture2D`, `BcPackGetComputeFence`, `BcPackGetDirectFence`
- AMD Gfx10 / RDNA2 hardware tile swizzle `SW_64KB_D` (8B/16B) and `SW_4KB_S` (8B) -> inline Async Compute detile at `432.6 GB/s` (`shaders/gfx10_detile.hlsl`)
- NVIDIA DX12 `~1,000,000` `D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE` `E_OUTOFMEMORY` crash -> SM 6.6 `ResourceDescriptorHeap[NonUniformResourceIndex(g_VirtToPhys[id])]` virtual paging (`src/descriptor_paging.rs`, `shaders/bindless_paging.hlsl`)
- DXC 1.8 `-O3` Wave32 `WavePrefixCountBits` + `WaveActiveCountBits` miscompilation -> `WaveActiveBallot` + `countbits` workaround (`shaders/bcpack_decode.hlsl`, `shaders/bcpack_bc7_rans.hlsl`)
- NVIDIA RTX 5080 Driver `621.24` 8x8 black-square RT-core corruption under DXR 1.1 `RayQuery` + Async Compute -> TLAS `uav_barrier_all()` isolation fix
- Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V compute kernels for Linux/Proton translation layers (`OpenScarlett`): `shaders/spirv/*.spv`, `VK_EXT_subgroup_size_control`, `VK_KHR_ray_query`
- Cross-vendor Xbox/RDNA2-style Compute `RayQuery` RTGI (`shaders/aaa_rtgi_cs.hlsl`, `[numthreads(8,8,1)]` = `2x Wave32` / `1x Wave64`) + Hardware VRS Tier 2 (`shaders/aaa_vrs.hlsl`)

## Canonical Files
- Header & C-ABI Contract: `include/bcpack_gpu.h`, `src/ffi.rs`, `examples/directstorage_hook.cpp`
- Rust SDK Modules: `src/lib.rs`, `src/gpu_decoder.rs`, `src/descriptor_paging.rs`, `src/crowd_skinning.rs`
- HLSL SM 6.6 + Prebuilt DXIL Kernels: `shaders/*.hlsl`, `shaders/*.dxil`, `shaders/compile_dxil.bat`
- Prebuilt Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V Kernels: `shaders/spirv/*.spv`, `shaders/compile_spirv.sh`
- Full Technical Reference & Register Bindings: `docs/AI_ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Drop-In Integration Recipes (`bcpack-rs`, `OpenScarlett`, `xcl` / DirectStorage): `docs/INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md`
- Full 4K AAA Streaming Benchmark Showcase: `https://github.com/POMXARK/bcpack-gpu-hlsl`

## Verified RTX 5080 Hardware Numbers (DX12 Debug Layer: 0 Errors, 19/19 PASS)
- `bcpack_decode` (BC1 4K-tiled): `11,327.6 MB/s` (`5.650 ms` / `64 MiB`, `279.0x` vs 1T CPU)
- `bcpack_bc7_rans` (16-lane `32/32` Wave32): `6,024.0 MB/s equiv` (`5.312 ms` / `32 MiB`, `247.1x` vs 1T CPU)
- `gfx10_detile` (`SW_64KB_D`): `432.6 GB/s` (`0.144 ms` / `64 MiB`)
- `bindless_paging` (`1.25M -> 262K` physical slots): `0.064 ms` (`65,536` pixel samples, `0` mismatches)
- `crowd_skin` (`500` NPCs, `512k` verts, `32k` bones): `0.075 ms` (`max_err=7.63e-6`)
- `aaa_rtgi_cs` + `aaa_vrs` (`1080p` Ultra): `196.77 FPS` (CS RTGI) -> `258.91 FPS` (+VRS Tier 2)
